title: SMS Reminders for Pet Groomers & Dog Trainers

facts.fact: Remind1's own page claims that its SMS reminders lead to up to 90% fewer no-shows (vendor claim, not independently verified).
Remind1 states that setup takes 2 minutes.
Remind1 states that the first 10 reminders are free.
Remind1 states that after the free reminders, users only pay for the reminders they create, with prices varying by country on its pricing page (no specific price is given on this page).
facts.quote: After that, you only pay for the reminders you create.

facts.fact: Remind1's free trial is stated to require no credit card.
The page's recommended reminder schedule includes a confirmation sent when the appointment is booked and a reminder sent 1 day before the appointment.
The page states that a full grooming appointment can block a grooming table for two hours or more, so a missed slot loses that time.
facts.quote: A full groom can block your table for two hours or more.
